_notes: Register: all console strings moved to formal u/uw (brief: register u); existing je/jouw lines in both consoles rewritten.

Terms: application=aanmelding; application deadline=aanmelddeadline; task due date=uiterste datum; status (application state) vs fase (stage); consultation=adviesgesprek; mock interview=oefeninterview; dormitory=studentenhuisvesting; settling-in=aankomsthulp; add-on=extra dienst; scholarship=beurs; notarization=notariële waarmerking; standard admission letter=standaard toelatingsbrief; degree filter=opleidingsniveau; retention=retentie.
Sign in = inloggen (aanmelden would collide with 'aanmelding' = application).
Owner decision: plan is rendered 'pakket' (existing ws.tab.profile, matches student app) although the glossary's English avoids 'package'.
Owner decision: 'offers' kept as 'aanbiedingen' in university analytics (existing); 'toelatingsaanbiedingen' is more precise but long.
Owner decision: kept English loan terms GPA, SLA, pipeline, caseload, single sign-on, Hangyul Operations, Hangyul HQ; validated with --allow-same.
